fusions.name: Torn Stinger
fusions.desc: Drives a barbed sting in and tears free of it, dealing 8 damage and leaving the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Worker's Volley
fusions.desc: Looses 3 barbed stings at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 poison damage, with a 20% chance per hit to leave the target [Pinned] for 1 second.

fusions.name: Honey Snare
fusions.desc: Sets a baited snare at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, then deals 18 damage to the first enemy to come within 2 tiles and leaves it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Alarm Scent
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.
